newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed and Solidere steady on almost unchanged turnover on Tuesday on the Beirut Stock Exchange.
Banque Audi held steady at $18.125 while Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, rose to $13 from $12.875.
Turnover in BLC rose sharply to 16,525 shares from 3,500 a day earlier while a total of 25,527 Audi shares changed hands against Monday's 30,000.
Lebanon Invest Bank Share Index (LIBX), introduced by Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest on Tuesday, rose 0.48 percent to 112.67.
LIBX takes its base as 100 on January 20, 1997, the day Banque Audi became the second bank traded on the Bourse.
Solidere shares were steady with Solidere A shares steady at $10.25 and B shares also unchanged at $10.75.

Demand for Solidere A shares remained high with 111,390 shares changing hands from 139,600 shares a day earlier. This compared with a daily turnover of 40-50,000 in previous weeks and 80-100,000 last week.
Also traded on the BSE were 16,800 Eternit shares at $1.625, unchanged from February 26 when they were last traded.
Total BSE turnover was 198,348 shares for a value of $2,148,689 against 198,898 shares for a value of $2,295,083 on Monday.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.01 percent to 896.8 and the LISPI rose 0.1 percent to 82.02.
